A '''kimono''' was a type of garment. In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] temporarily dressed herself in a darkly patterned [[Color/Legends|crimson]]-and-black local kimono while on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].
